userContent.text:
Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure shows two rose curves plotted on separate polar grids, set side by side and labeled (a) and (b) beneath. Each grid is built from dotted concentric circles crossed by dotted radial spokes, with solid horizontal and vertical axes arrowed at all four ends. Panel (a) holds a teal curve of eight identical petals, all springing from the origin at equal angular intervals so that four lie along the axes and four along the diagonals between them; its caption reads r = acos(n theta), n even. Panel (b) holds a curve in the same teal weight but with only three petals, one pointing straight down along the negative vertical axis and the other two angled up to the left and up to the right, spaced a third of a turn apart; its caption reads r = asin(n theta), n odd. Every petal reaches out to roughly the same radius, so each curve fills a circular envelope. Setting the panels side by side isolates the parity of n as the only thing governing the count: an even n produces 2n petals while an odd n produces just n, and the eight-petal and three-petal drawings are the two cases of that rule.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Button/state for integer n: the learner steps through n values, the polar curve redraws with n petals for odd n and 2n petals for even n, making the parity rule visible instead of memorized.
- Toggle between cosine and sine forms: the learner switches r = a cos(n theta) and r = a sin(n theta), the rose rotates to a new orientation while the petal-count rule remains tied to n, separating orientation from parity.
- Slider for amplitude a: the learner changes a, every petal grows or shrinks to a new maximum radius without changing the number of petals, showing that a controls size rather than count.
- Equation input for the polar rose: learner edits r = a*cos(n*theta) or r = a*sin(n*theta), with fields for a and n; the graph redraws and petal count plus orientation update immediately.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Precalculus 2e, chapter 8: Further Applications of Trigonometry

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // Library: svgjs (raw SVG polar panels; two-panel faithful default + live parity exploration) (function () { var W = 1000, H = 540; var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%').viewbox(0, 0, W, H); var TEAL = '#0e7c9e', GRID = '#9aa0a6', AXIS = '#111111'; var R = 185, SCALE = R / 1.6; // world r=1 -> SCALE px var CIRCLES = [0.5, 1, 1.5]; // dotted concentric circles (world r) function px(cx, r, th) { return cx + r * SCALE * Math.cos(th); } function py(cy, r, th) { return cy - r * SCALE * Math.sin(th); } function arrow(g, x, y, ang) { var s = 9; var p1 = [x, y]; var p2 = [x - s * Math.cos(ang - 0.4), y - s * Math.sin(ang - 0.4)]; var p3 = [x - s * Math.cos(ang + 0.4), y - s * Math.sin(ang + 0.4)]; g.polygon(p1.concat(p2, p3).join(' ')).fill(AXIS); } function buildGrid(P) { var g = draw.group(); // dotted concentric circles + outer CIRCLES.concat([1.6]).forEach(function (r, i) { g.circle(2 * r * SCALE).center(P.cx, P.cy).fill('none') .stroke({ color: GRID, width: 1, dasharray: '2,3' }); }); // dotted radial spokes every 45 deg for (var k = 0; k < 8; k++) { var th = k * Math.PI / 4; g.line(P.cx, P.cy, px(P.cx, 1.6, th), py(P.cy, 1.6, th)) .stroke({ color: GRID, width: 1, dasharray: '2,3' }); } // solid axes with arrowheads at all four ends var e = 1.6 * SCALE + 16; g.line(P.cx - e, P.cy, P.cx + e, P.cy).stroke({ color: AXIS, width: 1.6 }); g.line(P.cx, P.cy - e, P.cx, P.cy + e).stroke({ color: AXIS, width: 1.6 }); arrow(g, P.cx + e, P.cy, 0); arrow(g, P.cx - e, P.cy, Math.PI); arrow(g, P.cx, P.cy - e, -Math.PI / 2); arrow(g, P.cx, P.cy + e, Math.PI / 2); return g; } function makePanel(cx, trig, a, n, eqId, tag) { var P = { cx: cx, cy: 235, trig: trig, a: a, n: n, eqId: eqId, tag: tag }; P.rFn = function (th) { return P.a * (P.trig === 'cos' ? Math.cos(P.n * th) : Math.sin(P.n * th)); }; buildGrid(P); P.curve = draw.group(); P.cap = draw.text('').font({ family: 'Georgia, serif', size: 22, style: 'italic' }) .attr({ 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }) .move(cx, 235 + R + 22); P.sub = draw.text(tag).font({ family: 'Georgia, serif', size: 22 }) .attr({ 'text-anchor': 'middle' }).move(cx, 235 + R + 52); return P; } function petalCount(P) { return (P.n % 2 === 0) ? 2 * P.n : P.n; } function caption(P) { var par = (P.n % 2 === 0) ? 'n even' : 'n odd'; P.cap.text('r = a' + P.trig + '(nθ), ' + par); P.cap.attr({ 'text-anchor': 'middle' }).move(P.cx, 235 + R + 22); } function drawCurve(P) { P.curve.clear(); var N = 720, pts = []; for (var i = 0; i <= N; i++) { var th = 2 * Math.PI * i / N; var r = P.rFn(th); pts.push([px(P.cx, r, th), py(P.cy, r, th)]); } P.curve.polyline(pts.map(function (p) { return p[0] + ',' + p[1]; }).join(' ')) .fill('none').stroke({ color: TEAL, width: 2.6, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }) .css('cursor', 'pointer') .on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('r = ' + P.a + '·' + P.trig + '(' + P.n + 'θ) → ' + petalCount(P) + ' petals', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Rose curve r = a·' + P.trig + '(nθ)', 'Parity of n sets the petal count: even n yields 2n petals, odd n yields n petals. ' + 'The trig function (cos vs sin) only rotates the orientation; a only scales the size.'); }); } var L = makePanel(250, 'cos', 1, 4, 'eqLeftInput', '(a)'); var Rr = makePanel(750, 'sin', 1, 3, 'eqRightInput', '(b)'); var panels = [L, Rr]; function syncEq(P) { var el = document.getElementById(P.eqId); if (el) el.value = P.a + '*' + P.trig + '(' + P.n + '*theta)'; } function redraw(P) { drawCurve(P); caption(P); } function redrawAll() { panels.forEach(function (P) { redraw(P); syncEq(P); }); } // global controls window.update_n = function (v) { panels.forEach(function (P) { P.n = v; P.rFn = mkFn(P); }); redrawAll(); }; window.update_a = function (v) { panels.forEach(function (P) { P.a = v; P.rFn = mkFn(P); }); redrawAll(); }; window.toggle_swap = function (on) { var t0 = L.trig, t1 = Rr.trig; if (on) { L.trig = 'sin'; Rr.trig = 'cos'; } else { L.trig = 'cos'; Rr.trig = 'sin'; } panels.forEach(function (P) { P.rFn = mkFn(P); }); redrawAll(); }; function mkFn(P) { return function (th) { return P.a * (P.trig === 'cos' ? Math.cos(P.n * th) : Math.sin(P.n * th)); }; } // equation inputs (per panel) function bindEq(P) { bindEquationInput(P.eqId, function (fn, src) { P.rFn = fn; var m = /^([0-9.]+)\*(cos|sin)\(([0-9]+)\*theta\)$/.exec(src.replace(/\s+/g, '')); if (m) { P.a = parseFloat(m[1]); P.trig = m[2]; P.n = parseInt(m[3], 10); } drawCurve(P); caption(P); }, { variables: ['theta'] }); } bindEq(L); bindEq(Rr); // demo steps var steps = [ { msg: 'Default: left r=a·cos(nθ) with even n=4 → 8 petals; right r=a·sin(nθ) with odd n=3 → 3 petals.', a: 1, nL: 4, nR: 3, swap: false }, { msg: 'Set n=3 (odd) on both: each rose now shows exactly n = 3 petals. Odd n → n petals.', a: 1, nL: 3, nR: 3, swap: false }, { msg: 'Set n=4 (even) on both: each rose shows 2n = 8 petals. Even n → 2n petals.', a: 1, nL: 4, nR: 4, swap: false }, { msg: 'Swap cos/sin: orientation rotates, but petal count stays tied to n (parity), not to the trig function.', a: 1, nL: 4, nR: 4, swap: true }, { msg: 'Raise amplitude a: every petal grows to a larger radius while the petal COUNT is unchanged. a controls size only.', a: 1.4, nL: 4, nR: 4, swap: true } ]; var cur = 0; function applyStep(i) { cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(steps.length - 1, i)); var s = steps[cur]; document.getElementById('aInput').value = s.a; document.getElementById('aVal').value = s.a; document.getElementById('swapInput').checked = s.swap; L.n = s.nL; Rr.n = s.nR; L.a = s.a; Rr.a = s.a; L.trig = s.swap ? 'sin' : 'cos'; Rr.trig = s.swap ? 'cos' : 'sin'; panels.forEach(function (P) { P.rFn = mkFn(P); }); redrawAll(); document.getElementById('nVal').value = s.nL; document.getElementById('nInput').value = s.nL; document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = s.msg; document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = cur + ' / ' + (steps.length - 1); } window.nextStep = function () { applyStep(cur + 1); }; window.prevStep = function () { applyStep(cur - 1); }; redrawAll(); applyStep(0); window.__markRendered(); })(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
